truthDraftAudit.review: Corrected 0-row versus SQLSTATE denial expectations; separated SELECT visibility from permissive UPDATE widening before fixed comparison. Original observations preserved, not analyzer successes.

sourceFacts.intent: Todo owner policy is explicitly named; custom authenticative helper and class-based SassClient prevent an end-to-end protection proof.
sourceFacts.gap: Client wrapped in project class; custom policy function, unsupported DDL/migration context. GRANT to anon alone is not a proven vulnerability.

sourceFacts.intent: Account policies and comments specify own-account reads/updates; requireUser checks claims and MFA through helpers.
sourceFacts.gap: Workspace package imports, catalog dependency contracts, tsconfig inheritance, helper transformation and partial source selection prevent request/client/ownership confirmation.

failureCasePack.verifiedFailure: v23 produced CONFIRMED_POLICY_EVIDENCE without review candidates despite an authored DB allowing ownership transfer or claim.
unknownHypotheses: No claim about deployed public app exploitation or actual request JWT application.
failureCasePack.regression: Explicit broad check versus omitted check; reversed old/new restriction; grant absence; restrictive policy; unknown predicate; ALTER and REVOKE.
failureCasePack.next: Do not add class/Proxy/workspace runtime semantics from this evidence alone.

limitations: Matrix TP means a justified declaration review candidate, not an exploited HTTP authorization flaw.
Application filters, verified identity calls, GRANT and RLS declarations are separate evidence.
Actual JWT application, deployed policies, role inheritance, triggers and administrative bypass are not verified.
PostgreSQL uses authored SQL only; public source SQL is never executed.
New public apps are Grade C; no warning is not a TN. All observed apps become regression material.
Validation is same-author post-implementation material, not an independent blind holdout.
Live GitHub App, paid Provider, public deployment and actual Supabase access were not tested.
